tool.description: Compare two archived scan frames without changing the instrument. Both are flattened the same way (default highpass: a median background of highpass_nm = 3 nm is removed, so steps and the bow of piezo creep do not dominate; plane keeps large features); frames with different geometry are resampled onto their overlap in scan-frame nm (at the coarser pixel size), and region (display pixels of frame_a) restricts the comparison. With align=true (default) the content of frame_b is registered to frame_a by sub-pixel normalized cross-correlation: registration.shift_nm is the displacement of the image content from frame_a to frame_b in scan-frame nm (shift_px in grid pixels), with the correlation peak and confidence = main peak / the best correlation farther away than twice the image's correlation length (close to 1 means ambiguous, e.g. a bare periodic lattice or parallel stripes; peak_at_search_limit means the shift was not found). The aligned difference (b minus shifted a, median offset and plane removed) is returned as a derived image (red = higher in b, blue = lower in b, white = unchanged, gray = outside the overlap) and archived with its values (difference.frame), so read_values and inspect work on it. Changed regions above 5 robust noise sigmas are numbered with centroid (x_nm, y_nm), sign, area_nm2 and peak change (peak_change_pm for Z). It measures change; it does not say why something changed. Keys carry their unit: _nm, _deg, _px, and for channel values _pm (Z), _pa (current), _hz (frequency shift), _v (voltage).

align.description: Register b to a before subtracting. Default true.

channel.description: Channel, e.g. 'Z' or 'Current'. Default: the frame's default channel.

flatten.description: Background removed from both frames before registering and subtracting. Default highpass (median background of highpass_nm), so steps and the bow of piezo creep do not dominate the correlation; use plane to compare large features.

highpass_nm.description: Background width in nm for flatten='highpass'. Default 3.

region.description: Rectangle in display pixels of the frame's full image: origin at the top-left corner, x to the right, y down (the coordinates act accepts with a frame id).
